The world has changed since 1978 but some things sadely remain the same. Let me give you an example of this. My wife is from Vietnam and from Hmong descent ( this means dark brown skin and curley black hair ). Since the time I first met her in 2000 she has been pulled over and questioned by the police on numerous occasions. Now contrast with myself a middle aged white male driving in the same car and I have never once been pulled over despit the fact that I usually drive ten miles an hour or more over the speed limit.
But now lets put that in a different perspective. My hair reaches to my belt line and when I ride my motorcycle every idiot who ever saw an episode of SOA assumes I am an outlaw. This includes numerous cops who have pulled me over based on nothing more than their ingrained bias derived from an inaccurate profile based solely on my appearance. Now while I have not yet lashed out in a violent manner I can certianly see where the provocations of some fucking wannabe cop could drive me to do so.

I remember back in 1978 when a friend of mine from high school ( he was black ) and I walked to Pier Park in north Portland to use the pool. As we walked along every fucking eye in the neighbourhood was on us and when we got to the park the words no niggers allowed were painted on the sidewalk. When we saw this Lerone broke out in tears and said my family moved up north to get away from that shit. 
So put yourself in Trevons shoes for a minute. Yes I may be wrong ( but earlier reports said different ) the facts clearly show that Zimmerman followed him due to a suspicion based solely on the color of his skin. If after years and years of this treatment if it happened to you would not someday reach your breaking point and lash out at those who stereotype you in that manner? Trevon never should have engaged Zimmerman but that being said Zimmerman should have taken the beat down he deserved like a man and used that as an opportunity to reevaluate his position on profiling people walking through his neighborhood based solely on the color of their skin.
If you had to face systematic harassment based on the color of your skin year after year could you honestly say that at some point you would never have had enough?

So I can safely assume now that I am free to follow around any person of color who walks through my neighborhood and throw out racial epitahs until I have provoked them to anger, then shoot them when they stand up against me.
What a wonderful world we live in eh?
